note: USACE campground on wooded points on the south-east shore of Rend Lake near the dam; the Rend Lake Bike Trail runs through. Only a couple of sites reach the water: 056, on the point east of the power line, has open grass under tall trees sloping gently about 25 m to the lake, and 057 beside it sits about 13 m from the water at the top of a short steep bank. 083 and 084 look over the north shore from a pine grove atop a 6 m bank. Most others are 40 m or more back in the woods. --Claude
summary: rec.gov facility, rates, catalog, calendar and site photos read; imagery + 3DEP. 160 sites (146 electric at 50 A + 14 walk-to tent), water at 51, sewer at 46, back-in to 94 ft; 2027 fees $20/$24/$28 (stored 18-26 were 2026); season 03-26..11-07. Lakefront kept narrowly on 056 (open grass slope ~25 m) and 057, with a caveat; 083/084 are lakeview atop a 6 m bank. Pin moves ~520 m to the sites.
flags: WATERFRONT: lakefront kept, narrowly, with a caveat in the note naming the sites. 056 (38.039806,-88.934973): the 2023 rec.gov site photo shows open mown grass with clear trunks to the lake; from above it sits under tall crowns; 3DEP falls evenly 13 ft over ~26 m (421.6 -> 408.2 ft), a walk-across slope, not a bluff. 057 (38.039939,-88.935343): ~13 m from the water, photo shows its table near the edge, but 3DEP has a short steep bank (6 ft in ~4 m) at the end. Both are reservable nightly electric+water sites. Lakeview only: 083 (38.04044,-88.939078) and 084 (38.040432,-88.93949) in an open pine grove 18-25 m from the north shore but atop a ~6 m bank (428 -> 415 ft in 6 m); 058, 111, 112 25-30 m behind denser trees. Not on the water: 079/080 (forest 50 m+), BLOD 028-037 (30 m+ of forest to a cove), the rest. This hangs on 056: if a reviewer reads a 13-ft grass fall under canopy as set back up a slope, it becomes lakeview (Coon Creek 1698 went down at 15 m / 5.7 m up steep wooded banks; North Sandusky 1704 stayed at ~30 m / 7-11 ft over open grass).
PIN: stored 38.033844,-88.940156 is the rec.gov facility point by the entrance road, ~520 m south-west of the sites. Move to 38.0378,-88.9369 (all-site centroid).
